open_points.subject: run_service
open_points.text: Each name of the imported STOP_SIGNALS constant selects the member of that name of the operating system's signal enumeration by indexing the enumeration with the name, never by attribute lookup; every such signal exists on the Linux host, so its handler is installed unconditionally and its presence is never tested.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the prescribed indexing operation and attribute-lookup prohibition with a behavioral requirement to resolve every imported STOP_SIGNALS name to its corresponding operating-system signal and install its handler unconditionally, without specifying the expression or access mechanism.
